commits.summary: Set up the JBMC fast-follow brief's libraries, sources, tools and JVM controls
commits.body: Mechanical setup for llm-dlc/loops/jbmc-fast-follow-calls-conversions-and-arrays.md, recorded in its -setup.md. Resolved Guava 33.4.8-jre, Commons Lang 3.17.0, Collections 4.5.0, Math 3.6.1 and Jackson 2.19.0 from Maven Central with strict checksums; all 23 jars and sources jars have good signatures in a keyring of the setup's own, and jackson-databind matches the brief's sha256. Fetched the five source commits the brief links into shared bare mirrors; each is exactly its release tag, and the named files equal the released sources jars. Re-took both JBMC 6.11.0 packages' digests and extracted Comparator.class and Arrays.class from the Temurin 21.0.13 image (both equal the brief's digests). Built the checker's release binary at this head. Compiled the appendix fixtures on JDK 21 and ran every JVM control: all behave as the brief says (209 graphs with 12 shared rows, 21 matrix shapes 8/7/6, the 0x5a800001 vs 0x5a800000 witness, +0.0f at 2^-150, the disagreement classification on 8,192 bins). No claims, examples, JBMC or verifier runs; no verification job was needed, as every case is an unmodified release.

commits.summary: Propose the Adoptium key file name for the allow list
commits.body: The setup session for the JBMC fast-follow brief listed the previous setup's keys folder, whose Adoptium public key file is named after the key's public fingerprint; the long-token rule flagged it. Proposed (bdc3a059), not approved: a person decides.
